suggestions.quote: You love Mom; Sent is nearly empty.
suggestions.fix: If this is spoken, it names the feeling and tells the viewer what the picture already shows. Cut "You love Mom" and let the panel speak: "Sent. Mom's bar is a sliver. A sliver." Repeating the key word gives the line a take that is hushed and ashamed.

suggestions.quote: people guess far more of a room noticed them than did
suggestions.fix: This reads like an essay. Speak it as: "You'd bet the whole carriage looked. Most didn't." Keep one number, read aloud, e.g. "about half as many as you guessed", once the G2 source confirms it. Direction: amused, then gently dry.
